This document outlines the major maintenance procedure P1, which 
 must be performed every 40,000 operating hours 
 as indicated by H40,000 in the above 
titled block

The first draft is initiated by eng. Samir Abed Elglilil, tested by eng. Abd el 
kader Fath Alla at 20 Feb 2003, revised by EDEPC quality control engineer Abouda El Bana, 
accepted by general director eng. Sobhi elbakry, and approved by eng. Moneer 
Elwakil: head sector of Damietta combined cycle power station

 . etc
The HRSG are out of service & depressurized the high pressure section
Drain the high press. drum and put red tag on the feed water pumps
The inlet dampers are closed & locked mechanical
Disconnect the power supply for the damper actuators.
TIG welding machine
Grinder & grinding wheel
Selected filler metal for TIG welding
Cleaning tools & keys kit
Internal inspection for evidence of corrosion or scaling.
Internal inspection for cyclones, repair the defects.
Clean internal parts from the foreign bodies.
Check the feed water pipe clean and repair the defect.
Check manhole gasket if there is leakage.
Check blow down parts clean and repair the defect.
Inspect the perforated plate repair the defect.
Inspect all piping connections for evidence of corrosion.
Inspect insulation repair the defect.
Inspect the opening for down comers
Inspect the passivition layer for inner surface
Check water level glass and change if needed
Check valves and repair the defect

text:
Introduction
This document outlines the major maintenance procedure P1, which 
 must be performed every 40,000 operating hours 
 as indicated by H40,000 in the above 
titled block
The first draft is initiated by eng. Samir Abed Elglilil, tested by eng. Abd el 
kader Fath Alla at 20 Feb 2003, revised by EDEPC quality control engineer Abouda El Bana, 
accepted by general director eng. Sobhi elbakry, and approved by eng. Moneer 
Elwakil: head sector of Damietta combined cycle power station
Technical Data

Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
maintenance stuff should be carry the suitable safety categoryA work permit must be issued and the qualified 
maintenance stuff should be carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks 
surrounding the work area is required
Wear your safety helmet, safety shoes
 . etc
The HRSG are out of service & depressurized the high pressure section
Drain the high press. drum and put red tag on the feed water pumps
The inlet dampers are closed & locked mechanical
Disconnect the power supply for the damper actuators.
Tools and Equipment
TIG welding machine
Grinder & grinding wheel
Selected filler metal for TIG welding
Cleaning tools & keys kit
Work to be Carried Out
Internal inspection for evidence of corrosion or scaling.
Internal inspection for cyclones, repair the defects.
Clean internal parts from the foreign bodies.
Check the feed water pipe clean and repair the defect.
Check manhole gasket if there is leakage.
Check blow down parts clean and repair the defect.
Inspect the perforated plate repair the defect.
Inspect all piping connections for evidence of corrosion.
Inspect insulation repair the defect.
Inspect the opening for down comers
Inspect the passivition layer for inner surface
Check water level glass and change if needed
Check valves and repair the defect
